name.ja: 30MM オプションパーツセット ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 04
name.en: 30MM OPTION PARTS SET ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 04

ja: 『ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化！
シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、ガトリングガンを含めた武器群がオプションパーツセットで登場！
• 装備する際に左右で形状が変わる武装は再現用のパーツがそれぞれ付属し、選択式で組み立てが可能。
en: “ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON” items are commercialized in the “30 MINUTES MISSIONS” series!
Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," weapons including the Gatling gun are now available as optional parts sets!
• Weapons include "DF-GA-08 HU-BEN ", " DF-ET-09 TAI-YANG-SHOU ", " BML-G2/P17SPL-16 ", and " BML-G1/P20MLT-04".
• Weapons that change shape on the left and right when equipped come with parts for reproduction, and can be assembled selectively.
